verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents programmatic, UI-free operation: REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces, API-key onboarding with read/write scopes, and batch APIs (up to 100 requests per call) with webhooks. Together these support running video generation headlessly from automation pipelines, such as re-recording videos through the API when content changes. Missing for 10: any CI-specific documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions or non-interactive CLI usage), CLI coverage beyond a one-line mention, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
